My Tools💻
FREE MONTH voice to text: https://get.glaido.com/nate
Code NATEHERK for 10% off VPS (annual plan): https://www.hostinger.com/vps/claude-code-hosting

In this 5+ hour Codex course, I'll show you how to build useful AI tools and automations without a coding background. 

We'll use GPT-6 Astra to build your AI operating system and second brain, create reusable skills, make websites and branded deliverables, and generate and edit videos. 

I'll also cover browser use, voice mode, hosting automations, Codex vs. Claude Code, and how to price and sell AI solutions to clients.

Sponsorship Inquiries:
📧 nate@smoothmedia.co
